launch.question: When will the customer experience launch?
launch.answer: The customer experience is currently being prepared. Bharosa Hai is first building a verified provider network city by city.

free.question: Will Bharosa Hai be free to use?
free.answer: Customer access details will be announced before launch. Provider onboarding is currently free during the launch phase.

verified.question: How are professionals verified?
verified.answer: Providers submit profile details and documents. The admin team reviews identity, service category, credentials and profile quality.

cities.question: Which cities will be available first?
cities.answer: The initial city focus includes Mathura, Vrindavan, Agra, Delhi, Noida, Gurugram, Faridabad and Sonipat.

provider.question: Can I register as a provider today?
provider.answer: Yes. Service providers can create an account and complete the verification process now.
